login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to see the quotes from the people you follow.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start saving the lines that stay with you.
signup.confirmBody: Almost there. If {email} is a new account, we've sent you a link to confirm it. If you already had an account, check your inbox or sign in.
signup.consent: I have read and accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.

onboarding.title: Choose your username
onboarding.subtitle: This is how other readers will find you. You can change it later.
onboarding.usernameHint: Between 3 and 30 characters: letters, numbers and underscore.

err.passwordShort: The password must be at least 6 characters.
err.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Try again in a little while.
err.usernameFormat: Use between 3 and 30 characters: letters, numbers and underscore (_) only.
err.consentRequired: You must accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

hero.subtitle: Save the quotes from the books you read, add your page and your take, and discover what the people you follow are underlining.

heroQuotes.text: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
heroQuotes.author: Charles Dickens

heroQuotes.text: There is no friend as loyal as a book.
heroQuotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

heroQuotes.text: He who reads much and walks much, sees much and knows much.
heroQuotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

ribbon: A reader lives a thousand lives before dying.
Books are mirrors: you only see in them what you already carry inside.
To infinity and beyond the last page.
Reading is dreaming with your eyes open.
Every book you read is one more step up.
Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body.

features.heading: Your library of favorite lines
features.subheading: Everything you underline, in one place, and shared with whomever you like.

items.title: Quote and comment
items.body: Jot down the line that struck you, its page and why it hit home. Your library of highlights, organized.

items.title: Follow readers
items.body: Your feed fills up with quotes from the people you follow. Discover through the eyes of others.

items.title: Find your next read
items.body: Every quote is a door to a new book. Let the lines guide you to the next one.

finalCta.heading: Start your quote collection
finalCta.subtitle: Join for free and save the first line that takes your breath away.

feed.endSubtitle: This isn't the end: keep exploring readers and quotes from the community.

discovery.subtitleFollowing: Recent quotes from other readers you might want to follow.
discovery.subtitleNoFollows: In the meantime, take a look at what the community is sharing.

empty.title: Your feed is empty
empty.body: Publish your first quote or follow other readers to fill this page.

actions.shareAria: Share the quote as an image

endOfList.title: That's all, folks — the quotes have run out
endOfList.subtitle: You've reached the end. Come back soon: there's always a new line waiting.

quoteForm.notePlaceholder: Why it hit home, what it reminded you of…

editProfile.usernameHint: Between 3 and 30 characters. Changing it changes your profile URL.
editProfile.bioPlaceholder: Tell the world what you read…

editProfile.errUsernameFormat: The username must be 3-30 characters: letters, numbers and underscore.

quoteView.ctaTitle: Save the lines that stay with you
quoteView.ctaBody: librOpinion is a social network for readers: jot down the quotes from your books, add your take, and discover what the people you follow underline.

requests.title: Follow requests
requests.emptyBody: When someone requests to follow you, it'll appear here.

admin.banDesc: Their content will be hidden and they'll receive an email with the reason. Write it clearly.
admin.reasonPlaceholder: e.g.: Repeated insults to other users despite warnings.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account has been suspended for breaking the community rules. If you think this is a mistake, get in touch with us.
